how_it_works: One saturated silhouette per act: green arch, giant yellow ring, red-roof castle, rainbow, pink-flower finish arch
why_it_reads: A player can name the next target from 100+ blocks; each act has one dominant object

how_it_works: White cloud = safe ground; green = village/garden; blue = water/ice; brown = wood/dirt; magenta/pink = launch; red spiral = jump; yellow chevron = speed; black/green = direction
why_it_reads: Surface type is readable before the player lands on it; colour does the work geometry cannot

how_it_works: Yellow chevrons point forward and speed up; red spirals launch upward; blue/red rings gate elytra/water flight
why_it_reads: The same two textures recur on every leg, so the player learns them once; pads sit on the racing line, not hidden

how_it_works: Stone arch at the start, blue tube at 1:34, green finish arch at 2:56, narrow alley at 3:18
why_it_reads: The exit is a frame; the player sees the next beat through a hole rather than across the whole map

how_it_works: Black/green arrows on the floor at 1:38, 2:56, 3:23; floating black/green arrow panels at 2:50 and 3:10
why_it_reads: Arrows add a second channel when the geometry is ambiguous; they point at the pad or the gate, not at the void

how_it_works: Floating islands stacked above/below; look-up shot at 1:58; underside shots at 2:20/2:41
why_it_reads: The route is a stack, so the next level can be shown from below; the player reads height as progress

how_it_works: Checkpoint/lap arches and cave mouths hide the next section until the player is close
why_it_reads: Prevents the map from becoming a single wide bowl; each reveal is a small reward

how_it_works: The same pad/arch/checker vocabulary repeats in every act
why_it_reads: Teaches the language in the first 10 s and reuses it; no new UI is needed

how_it_works: Freecam and third-person shots show the route from angles the player never gets (from below, 50+ blocks away, HUD off)
why_it_reads: The video overstates how readable the route is in first person; do not copy the camera as gameplay

how_it_works: White cloud on white sky, grey stone on grey stone, dark blue cave on dark blue water
why_it_reads: At speed, the next platform can disappear; the map relies on pads/arrows to compensate

how_it_works: Giant creeper, floating text signs, flowers, cacti, checkerboard walls, multiple competing colours
why_it_reads: Visual identity is strong but the route can be lost in the noise; the best shots isolate one landmark

how_it_works: No lap/checkpoint/timer HUD; action bar always says 1st, even during the countdown
why_it_reads: The player cannot confirm progress or pace; this is the biggest presentation gap vs MCC
